title: SoK: Timestamps Are Not a Time Model: Rethinking Temporal Reasoning in Host-Based Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.35151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Host-based intrusion detectors order events, window audit streams and sequence attack stages by their timestamps. Every conclusion they draw therefore rests on assumptions about clocks, delivery, entity identity and the integrity of the evidence, and most of these assumptions go unstated. This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) makes them explicit. Drawing on temporal databases, stream processing and runtime verification, we distill five components of a time model, together with a checklist of evidence assumptions and four levels of guarantee, and walk through a running campaign with them. A documented search yields fifteen families of detection and investigation. For papers selected by screening role and period, plus named systems and landmarks, we check the stated assumptions in the full texts, and we assess eleven temporal knowledge representation and reasoning (KRR) formalisms and a learned baseline on nine attack patterns. translated_title: SoK：时间戳并非时间模型：重新思考基于主机的入侵检测中的时间推理
translated_abstract: 基于主机的入侵检测器依靠时间戳对事件进行排序、对审计流进行窗口化处理并排列攻击阶段的先后顺序。因此，它们得出的每一个结论都依赖于关于时钟、数据传递、实体身份以及证据完整性的假设，而这些假设大多未被明确说明。本文的知识系统化（SoK）工作将这些假设显式化。借鉴时态数据库、流处理和运行时验证领域的成果，我们提炼出时间模型的五个组成部分，并附上一份证据假设清单和四个保障等级，同时以一个持续的攻击活动为例进行演示。通过系统化的文献检索，我们归纳出十五类检测与调查方法。对于按角色和时间段筛选出的论文以及知名系统和里程碑式工作，我们核查了其全文中陈述的假设，并在九种攻击模式上评估了十一种时态知识表示与推理（KRR）形式化方法和一个学习型基线方法。有些……（摘要原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文系统化地揭示了基于主机入侵检测中隐含的时间假设，提出时间模型的五个要素、证据假设清单和四级保障体系，并评估了十一种时态知识表示与推理形式化方法在九种攻击模式上的表现。
en_tdlr: This SoK makes explicit the unstated temporal assumptions underlying host-based intrusion detection, distilling five components of a time model, a checklist of evidence assumptions, and four guarantee levels, while evaluating eleven temporal KRR formalisms against nine attack patterns.
